content.what_it_is: Python port of the beach_2d plot_wave.m script ('PLOT WAVE for 2D CASE' @L1): imports numpy/matplotlib/os (L4-L6); fdir hardcoded to a Windows USACE Funwave-Seminar results path @L9 (comment L7-L8 says to edit); loads eta_00001 for grid shape (L12, L15), dx=dy=2.0 (L16-L17), coordinates (L19-L20), sponge outline (L23-L24), wavemaker outline (L26-L27). Plots two snapshots nfile=[10,50] @L30 with labels min=['20','100'] @L31 in a 10x5-inch dpi-200 figure @L39: per snapshot loads eta_/mask_ (L43-L44), masks dry cells with np.ma.masked_where @L46, pcolor with 'coolwarm' @L50, title @L52-L53, sponge/wavemaker outlines with rotated labels (L57-L61), ylabel+xlabel on first panel, xlabel+colorbar labelled eta (m) on second (L63-L69); saves 'eta_2d_wave.png' @L73.
